description: Hi there! We are Tesseract Engineers, a team of five cool people with a passion for science, technology, and engineering. We still have a lot to learn, but we are ambitious, curious, and ready to work hard. We want to win while tackling real-world problems, but above all, we want to learn as much as possible, grow together, and turn our ideas into something incredible and useful.
summary: Tesseract: Mission Control is an interactive educational video game that makes space mission design accessible and engaging for everyone. Players design their own space missions by selecting a scientific objective, launch vehicle, spacecraft, scientific instruments, and managing essential resources such as budget, mass, power, communications, data, and mission lifetime. Through four scientific challenges — Earth observation, solar exploration, planetary science, and understanding the universe — participants discover how each engineering decision influences the overall mission. Through four scientific challenges — Earth observation, solar exploration, planetary science, and understanding the universe — players experience real-world engineering trade-offs, make strategic decisions, and simulate mission outcomes. Our goal is to transform complex aerospace concepts into an enjoyable learning experience that encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration while inspiring the next generation of space explorers and engineers.
details:
TESSERACT: MISSION CONTROL 👩‍🚀 ❤️ 🚀

Design. Explore. Discover.

-> What is it? 🤔

An interactive space mission design game that transforms the process of designing and managing a complete space mission into an accessible, hands-on experience.

-> How does it work? 😲

First, the players encounter a menu that displays:

  • PLAY SOLO:👩‍🚀Individual players choose a scientific objective, select a launch vehicle, design a spacecraft, choose scientific instruments, and configure mission parameters such as orbit, mass, power, communications, budget, and mission lifetime. Each decision influences the mission's performance and scientific success. Players can explore different scenarios, face unexpected challenges, and test their designs through mission simulations.
  • PLAY WITH FRIENDS AND COMPETE! You should click on "create private room," or if you already have a room, you should ask the creator to give you the code, and click "join private room" to enter the code.
  • HOW TO PLAY:🧑‍💻A series of basic instructions to play "Tesseract: Mission Control".
  • HOW DOES NASA...? 🛰️Here is where you can find part of the educational value of the game. There is a series of mini tutorials to complement the learning, using NASA data as examples so that the player can be more familiar with a REAL Space Mission design, together with some other available resources.

Inside View 🔍:

->What benefits does it have?

Tesseract: Mission Control turns space exploration into an accessible, hands-on learning experience. By engaging players in realistic mission design challenges, it strengthens STEM literacy, critical thinking, problem-solving, and interdisciplinary collaboration. It connects scientific concepts with practical engineering applications, encourages experimentation and innovation, and introduces players to the challenges and opportunities of aerospace and science careers. Most importantly, it inspires curiosity, broadens access to STEM learning, and empowers the next generation to become active contributors to scientific discovery and space exploration.

-> Our main goal for impact:

We want science, space exploration, and engineering to reach EVERYONE, regardless of their previous scientific or technical knowledge. We want players to understand the complexity of designing real space missions, but even more importantly, we want to inspire curiosity about space, encourage interest in STEAM fields, and ultimately, we hope to transform learning into an experience that motivates the next generation of scientists, engineers, and explorers.

-> TOOLS, CODING AND SOFTWARE:

Development of interactive systems and user interface.
  • JavaScript.
  • HTML.
  • CSS.
Development environment and interactive 3D experience.
  • PlayCanvas.
Creation and preparation of 3D models and visual assets.
  • Blender.

What makes us different? 🚀

We built the game we, as science enthusiasts, have always wished existed. We understand firsthand the gap between humanity's curiosity to explore and the limited access to the resources and experiences that make scientific discovery possible. We know what it means to have questions about the universe but few opportunities to explore the engineering behind its exploration. That is why we did not set out to create a perfect solution, but an innovative one: a way to turn curiosity into exploration, complex engineering into accessible experiences, and imagination into the first step toward discovery.

-> What factors did we consider? 🎖️

  1. Scientific accuracy.
  2. Educational value
  3. Technical feasibility.
  4. Easy for everyone but interesting at any level.
  5. Realistic engineering constraints.
  6. Prioritized intuitive navigation.
  7. Visual clarity.
  8. Replayability.
  9. Learn through experimentation.
  10. Collaboration.

-> What did we use AI for?

We used AI as support throughout the development of our project. It helped us research scientific concepts, organize information, explore ideas, improve our code, and solve technical problems.

However, the core idea, game concept, creative direction, mission design, and most of the content were originally developed by our team. AI was used as an assisting tool, NOT as a substitute for our creativity, research, or decision-making. Every suggestion was reviewed, adapted, and evaluated by our team.
